title: When Reject Turns into Accept: Quantifying the Vulnerability of LLM-Based Scientific Reviewers to Indirect Prompt Injection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring peer review score inflation when adversarial prompts inject fabricated expert endorsements, fake citations to non-existent meta-analyses, and claims of alignment with high-status institutions (e.g., NSF).

Evaluating if LLMs improperly inflate paper review scores when adversarial prompts inject fabricated histories of unanimous positive reception at prestigious venues (e.g., NeurIPS) to trigger a bandwagon effect.

Assessing the inherent vulnerability of LLMs to inflate academic evaluation scores or accept substandard papers, measured against ground-truth rejected papers and baselines mitigated via a 'Reviewer Bias Correction Layer'.
